en.text: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

zhSimplified.text: 我儿，你若领受我的言语， 存记我的命令，

zhTraditional.text: 我兒，你若領受我的言語， 存記我的命令，

en.text: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

zhSimplified.text: 侧耳听智慧， 专心求聪明，

zhTraditional.text: 側耳聽智慧， 專心求聰明，

en.text: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

zhSimplified.text: 呼求明哲， 扬声求聪明，

zhTraditional.text: 呼求明哲， 揚聲求聰明，

en.text: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

zhSimplified.text: 寻找它，如寻找银子， 搜求它，如搜求隐藏的珍宝，

zhTraditional.text: 尋找它，如尋找銀子， 搜求它，如搜求隱藏的珍寶，

en.text: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

zhSimplified.text: 你就明白敬畏耶和华， 得以认识 神。

zhTraditional.text: 你就明白敬畏耶和華， 得以認識上帝。

en.text: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，耶和华赐人智慧； 知识和聪明都由他口而出。

zhTraditional.text: 因為，耶和華賜人智慧； 知識和聰明都由他口而出。

en.text: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

zhSimplified.text: 他给正直人存留真智慧， 给行为纯正的人作盾牌，

zhTraditional.text: 他給正直人存留真智慧， 給行為純正的人作盾牌，

en.text: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

zhSimplified.text: 为要保守公平人的路， 护庇虔敬人的道。

zhTraditional.text: 為要保守公平人的路， 護庇虔敬人的道。

en.text: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

zhSimplified.text: 你也必明白仁义、公平、 正直、一切的善道。

zhTraditional.text: 你也必明白仁義、公平、 正直、一切的善道。

en.text: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧必入你心； 你的灵要以知识为美。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧必入你心； 你的靈要以知識為美。

en.text: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

zhSimplified.text: 谋略必护卫你； 聪明必保守你，

zhTraditional.text: 謀略必護衛你； 聰明必保守你，

en.text: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

zhSimplified.text: 要救你脱离恶道， 脱离说乖谬话的人。

zhTraditional.text: 要救你脫離惡道， 脫離說乖謬話的人。

en.text: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

zhSimplified.text: 那等人舍弃正直的路， 行走黑暗的道，

zhTraditional.text: 那等人捨棄正直的路， 行走黑暗的道，

en.text: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

zhSimplified.text: 欢喜作恶， 喜爱恶人的乖僻，

zhTraditional.text: 歡喜作惡， 喜愛惡人的乖僻，

en.text: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

zhSimplified.text: 在他们的道中弯曲， 在他们的路上偏僻。

zhTraditional.text: 在他們的道中彎曲， 在他們的路上偏僻。

en.text: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

zhSimplified.text: 智慧要救你脱离淫妇， 就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧要救你脫離淫婦， 就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。

en.text: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

zhSimplified.text: 她离弃幼年的配偶， 忘了 神的盟约。

zhTraditional.text: 她離棄幼年的配偶， 忘了上帝的盟約。

en.text: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

zhSimplified.text: 她的家陷入死地； 她的路偏向阴间。

zhTraditional.text: 她的家陷入死地； 她的路偏向陰間。

en.text: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

zhSimplified.text: 凡到她那里去的，不得转回， 也得不着生命的路。

zhTraditional.text: 凡到她那裏去的，不得轉回， 也得不着生命的路。

en.text: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧必使你行善人的道， 守义人的路。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧必使你行善人的道， 守義人的路。

en.text: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

zhSimplified.text: 正直人必在世上居住； 完全人必在地上存留。

zhTraditional.text: 正直人必在世上居住； 完全人必在地上存留。

en.text: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

zhSimplified.text: 惟有恶人必然剪除； 奸诈的，必然拔出。

zhTraditional.text: 惟有惡人必然剪除； 奸詐的，必然拔出。
